notes: 1.code_for_chnsRF.sas builds PROC FORMAT value labels and PROC FREQ/MEANS summaries over CHNS survey extracts read from a private cnhsdata libname. That libname is unavailable outside the authors' environment, so this bundle keeps their format-and-summarize flow and runs it against an inline sample of 18 real rows (breast/lung/liver cancer, 2007-2012) lifted from the repo's own 4.female_all.csv, instead of the unavailable libname read.
